title: Dynamics of the leftmost particle in heterogeneous semi-infinite exclusion systems
summary: We study the behaviour of the leftmost particle in a semi-infinite particle system on $\mathbb{Z}$, where each particle performs a continuous-time nearest-neighbour random walk, with particle-specific jump rates, subject to the exclusion interaction (i.e., no more than one particle per site). We give conditions, in terms of the jump rates on the system, under which the leftmost particle is recurrent or transient, and develop tools to study its rate of escape in the transient case, including by comparison with an $M/G/\infty$ queue.
